notes.title: Online Multiplayer Available Now
notes.content:
Hi there!

Smackball has online multiplayer now! 

This feature was previously available on the [b]beta[/b] branch as a preview, but it has been moved to the [b]default[/b] Smackball branch. Currently, there are two types of online matches you can play:
[list]
[*] [b]Private:[/b] Host a match and invite a Steam friend to play with you.
[*] [b]Public:[/b] Match up against a random player.
[/list]

As previously mentioned, since this is a big update, the price of the game has been slightly increased. The game now costs $4.99 or equivalent.

Cheers,
Vidak

notes.title: Online Multiplayer Preview
notes.content:
Hi there!

An online multiplayer mode has been added to Smackball. There's a preview of it on Smackball's [b]beta[/b] branch. 

There are two types of online matches you can play:
[list]
[*] [b]Private:[/b] Host a match and invite a Steam friend to play with you.
[*] [b]Public:[/b] Match up against a random player.
[/list]
All game modes can be played online, but the CUSTOM mode is only available for private matches.

Some core gameplay changes have also been made:
[list]
[*] There's now a short 'cooldown' period after shooting. This makes spamming the shoot button a bit more difficult.
[*] Paddle sizes have been slightly decreased,
[/list]

In order to check out the beta, you'll need to:
[olist]
[*] Open the Steam client and naviagte to your [b]Library[/b].
[*] From the Smackball page, open the [b]Properties[/b] window from the [b]Manage[/b] menu.
[*] Select the [b]BETAS[/b] tab.
[*] Select the [b]beta[/b] branch from the dropdown menu.
[*] Smackball will then be updated to the latest beta.
[/olist]

[b]NOTE:[/b] The online multiplayer should soon go out of beta, after which it'll be moved to the [b]default[/b] Smackball branch. When that happens, the price of the game will be slightly increased.

Cheers,
Vidak
